    <!-- 2. CITATION (v3) -->
    <section class="intro fade-in">
        <div class="intro__container">
            <p class="intro__quote">Lagoa de Obidos is a true saltwater playground. Glassy, flat water. Consistent wind.</p>
            <p class="intro__body">A freestyle and freeride paradise for kitesurfing and wing foiling. This is where beginners build real confidence. Where progression feels natural and new skills are unlocked.</p>
            <p class="intro__body">Welcome to your wind-powered basecamp — where beginners find confidence, intermediates level up, experienced riders refine the details. No chaos, no ego. Just epic sessions, good people and that feeling you chase every time you hit the water.</p>
            <p class="intro__body" style="font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-sun);">Welcome to our lagoon paradise. Let's ride.</p>
